title: Who revived Tin Roof Blues-type tune 'T.O. Sand'
summary: Bergen and Allen trace which local players kept a tune alive, naming Mike Trapani and Francis Murray.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You know, while I'm talking about all these tunes I forgot one. Who featured T.O. Sand?
Down here? Mike Trapani I believe was the guy that kept playing it. And of course it was old then. Now they might have played it out at Spanish Fort in the old days, I don't know.
Well I used to have Francis Murray play it.
Yeah, well he played with, I played that tune with him, he might have it on a record in the jazz club.

I think Francis one time and Bill Kress played a job with Mike Trapani and he liked that tune and I believe that's where they started playing it. And if I'm not mistaken, Pete Font was at the club that night and wanted to know the name
That was a long time ago. I don't think Pete was still maybe with Al Hood at that time, with the bass of Street Six
